mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS below 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic conditions.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of triggered instances, or Rank IC over 2-year windows falls below 0.03.
